title: HyGen: Efficient LLM Serving via Elastic Online-Offline Request Co-location
technique: online-offline co-location: linear-regression batch-latency predictor + SLO-aware profiler setting a per-batch latency budget; SLO-aware offline scheduling with prefix-sharing maximization and starvation prevention

optimized_metrics.evidence: formulated as a constrained optimization problem that maximizes throughput with prefix sharing while preserving strict latency SLOs

headline_claim.text: HyGen achieves up to 3.9-5.8x throughput gains over online and hybrid serving baselines, while ensuring latency SLOs.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Online serving demands low and stable response times, measured by Time to First Token (TTFT) and Time Between Tokens (TBT)
metric_definitions.notes: TTFT and TBT not otherwise formally defined (used without definition)

metric_definitions.definition_quote: For interference evaluation, we focus on Time to First Token (TTFT) and Time Between Tokens (TBT), including their mean and 99th percentile (P99) values. Throughput is measured in tokens per second (TPS) and queries per second (QPS).
metric_definitions.notes: both mean and P99 used as SLO statistics; throughput TPS (token type not stated) and QPS

metric_definitions.definition_quote: HyGen's ability to meet stringent SLOs under varying online QPS settings on the four aforementioned metrics, each with 5% interference tolerance.
metric_definitions.notes: SLO expressed as allowed % degradation of an online metric vs online-only baseline (tolerance 5%-50%, e.g. P99 TTFT 8%, mean TBT 10-50%); inferred from usage, baseline definition not stated verbatim

slo_spec: SLOs are relative: interference tolerance ratio (e.g. 5%, 8%, 10-50%) applied to one or more of mean/P99 TTFT and mean/P99 TBT; the profiler binary-searches a batch-latency budget to meet the SLO on online requests. Multiple SLOs can be met simultaneously.
load_regime: trace replay (Azure LLM inference conversation trace 2023, Mooncake trace) scaled to a target QPS, with an offline backlog (arXiv summarization)
tradeoff_acknowledged: Online SLO headroom vs offline throughput: looser interference tolerance yields higher offline throughput; HyGen gets up to 84.3% of pure-offline Sarathi total throughput.
workloads: Azure LLM inference trace 2023 (online); Mooncake trace; arXiv summarization, CNN/DailyMail, MMLU (offline)
extractor_notes: Rare case where both mean and P99 are separate SLO targets for TTFT and TBT. TTFT/TBT never formally defined. Token type for TPS not stated.

tail_audit.metrics: TBT and TTFT @ mean or P99 (selectable SLO metric, tolerance ratio)
